public_claim_boundary: This file tracks external blockers for GitHub issue creation. It does not claim resolution of any external dependency.

issues.title: Kaggle Docker execution spec confirmation
issues.body:
Kaggle needs to confirm the expected container shape, metadata paths, artifact format, and scoring interface for AuthZBench-SaaS. Without this spec, we cannot validate that our Harbor adapter generates compliant containers.

Blocked by: Kaggle/Google platform team
Repo-side status: Harbor dataset skeleton builder is ready; adapter can be adjusted once spec is provided.
Reference: docs/kaggle-harbor-integration-brief.md

issues.title: Kaggle platform acceptance decision
issues.body:
Only Kaggle can accept, host, or endorse the benchmark. This issue tracks the platform acceptance decision.

Blocked by: Kaggle/Google
Repo-side status: Host-review package is ready for review. See docs/host-review-package.md and docs/current-status-for-kaggle.md.
Reference: docs/kaggle-hosting-model.md

issues.title: Harbor platform publishing / official review
issues.body:
Local Harbor parity is verified (6/6 tasks, 100% match rate), but Harbor review/publishing/endorsement is external. This issue tracks the Harbor platform acceptance path.

Blocked by: Harbor platform team
Repo-side status: Local parity verified. See artifact/harbor-parity-experiment.json.
Reference: artifact/harbor-adapter-readiness-blockers.json (harbor_review_or_publish_path)

issues.title: SaaS-provider / product-security validation
issues.body:
Requires actual SaaS or product-security reviewers to validate whether task scenarios reflect real authorization failures. Review packet is ready.

issues.title: Hosted private holdout execution environment
issues.body:
Requires a host-controlled or maintainer-operated private runner environment to execute private holdout evaluation. Cannot be completed without platform infrastructure.

Blocked by: Kaggle/Google or maintainer infrastructure
Repo-side status: Private holdout design, custody protocol, and rotation policy are documented. See docs/private-holdout-lifecycle.md and docs/privacy-and-holdout-custody.md.

issues.title: Third-party participant submissions
issues.body:
Requires platform operation and participant onboarding infrastructure. Cannot be completed without a hosted environment.

Blocked by: Platform acceptance and hosted infrastructure
Repo-side status: Submission schema, validators, and governance documented. See docs/v1-community-submission-governance.md.
